values.note: 27 full-facility RV/tent sites plus six tent-only sites; 'Some sites can accommodate rigs up to 70 feet' (Reserve Florida's catalog lists 93 ft for the RV or Tent type). Separate primitive equestrian camp (20 sites, booked by phone), hike-in primitive camps and a group camp.

summary: Confirmed on the park's own amenities page: Reserve Florida booking with an 11-month window (inherited values now entry-scoped), 27 full-facility sites with 30/50-amp, rigs to 70 ft, dump station, accessible bathhouse. Whether sites have water and sewer at the pad is not stated ('full-facility' only), nor showers or a campground season. Fees ($24 + $7 utility, read 2026-10-12) left as recorded; note unchanged.
